units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
Laughing.
Yes, exactly, and on one’s back at night. Thank you, I can walk alone.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Dear me, what formality!
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: He and SORIN go out.
He gave me a dreadful fright.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: It is not good for him to live in the country. Mother, if you would only untie your purse-strings for once, and lend him a thousand roubles! He could then spend a whole year in town.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: I have no money. I am an actress and not a banker.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: A pause.
Please change my bandage for me, mother, you do it so gently.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: ARKADINA goes to the cupboard and takes out a box of bandages and a bottle of iodoform.
The doctor is late.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Yes, he promised to be here at nine, and now it is noon already.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Sit down.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She takes the bandage off his head.
You look as if you had a turban on. A stranger that was in the kitchen yesterday asked to what nationality you belonged. Your wound is almost healed.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She kisses his head.
You won’t be up to any more of these silly tricks again, will you, when I am gone?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: No, mother. I did that in a moment of insane despair, when I had lost all control over myself. It will never happen again.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: He kisses her hand.

Your touch is golden. I remember when you were still acting at the State Theatre, long ago, when I was still a little chap, there was a fight one day in our court, and a poor washerwoman was almost beaten to death. She was picked up unconscious, and you nursed her till she was well, and bathed her children in the washtubs. Have you forgotten it?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Yes, entirely.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She puts on a new bandage.
Two ballet dancers lived in the same house, and they used to come and drink coffee with you.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: I remember that.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: They were very pious.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: A pause.
I love you again, these last few days, as tenderly and trustingly as I did as a child. I have no one left me now but you. Why, why do you let yourself be controlled by that man?
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: You don’t understand him, Constantine. He has a wonderfully noble personality.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Nevertheless, when he has been told that I wish to challenge him to a duel his nobility does not prevent him from playing the coward. He is about to beat an ignominious retreat.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: What nonsense! I have asked him myself to go.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: A noble personality indeed! Here we are almost quarrelling over him, and he is probably in the garden laughing at us at this very moment, or else enlightening Nina’s mind and trying to persuade her into thinking him a man of genius.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: You enjoy saying unpleasant things to me. I have the greatest respect for that man, and I must ask you not to speak ill of him in my presence.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: I have no respect for him at all. You want me to think him a genius, as you do, but I refuse to lie: his books make me sick.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: You envy him. There is nothing left for people with no talent and mighty pretensions to do but to criticise those who are really gifted. I hope you enjoy the consolation it brings.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: With irony.
Those who are really gifted, indeed!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Angrily.
I am cleverer than any of you, if it comes to that!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: He tears the bandage off his head.

You are the slaves of convention, you have seized the upper hand and now lay down as law everything that you do; all else you strangle and trample on. I refuse to accept your point of view, yours and his, I refuse!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: That is the talk of a decadent.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Go back to your beloved stage and act the miserable ditch-water plays you so much admire!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: I never acted in a play like that in my life. You couldn’t write even the trashiest music-hall farce, you idle good-for-nothing!
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Miser!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Rag-bag!
units.name: ARKADINA
